exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a1a: Compact positive-price budget, interior dominance of axes, radial Hessian and tangent strictness give global unique Marshallian demand; zero wealth explicit.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a1b: Complete expenditure minimizer including zero target; attained Hicks bundle and global contradiction through indirect utility.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a1c: General matrix, exact old evaluation, square-form negative semidefiniteness and homogeneous null direction verified.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a1d: Reference-utility definitions lead to different exact CV and EV; actual expenditure unchanged does not identify welfare.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a2a: Profit and income use net profits; all household price domains interior or excluded, unique clearing and both resource accounts.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a2b: Optimal within-output allocation and strict global reduced welfare optimum; pollution invalidates undistorted welfare assumptions.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a2c: Corrective unit tax equals aggregate marginal damage; consumer/net price, profits, rebates and real numeraire all reconcile.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a2d: Both exact utility changes include consumption, numeraire and damages; Pareto result conditional on funded equal rebates/ownership.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a3a: All equal/unequal positive and zero pure price cases exhausted; sole pure stage equilibrium established without mixed-equilibrium assertion.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a3b: Unattained undercut supremum handled in necessity at threshold; bounded discounted truncation proves arbitrary-history deviations unprofitable.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a3c: False-alarm continuation probability and exact threshold derived; public signal law and certain deviation detection explicit.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a3d: Prompt and proof restrict finite-horizon conclusion to pure strategies. Backward induction valid; fixed quantity implies surplus redistribution, not deadweight loss.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a4a: Statewise positive net-gain comparison and exact uniform integral prove global efficient allocation, no trade at tie.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a4b: All-report constant payments and winning/losing limits force buyer cost and seller value thresholds; global DSIC and ex-post IR verified.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a4c: Normalized efficient threshold mechanism has statewise deficit, expected subsidy and attained worst-report reserve. Sponsor loss included in consolidation.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a4d: Exact posted-price integral and strict quadratic establish global restricted-class optimum and first-best shortfall.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a5a: Private training choices, monotone compliance types, first stage and wage ITT independently reconstructed from primitive types.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a5b: Random assignment/exclusion/complier decomposition produces Wald LATE; differs from universal gross ATE and resource welfare.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a5c: All subsidy payments funded by external owner; private gains, taxpayer cost and real training-cost change consolidate despite positive wage ITT.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-a5d: Concrete prospective design addresses private funding, separate cost/outcomes, design uncertainty, exclusion threat, transport and prespecified revision.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b1a: Complete global selected-set demand on both price branches and tie; disconnected endpoints violate convex preferences.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b1b: Two feasible expenditure branches give concave minimum function and complete Hicks set; nonconvexity does not prevent minimum attainment.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b1c: Nonlinear directional derivative disproves differentiability. Convex-combination supergradient has too-low utility and is not Hicks demand.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b1d: Zero compensation at changed prices is compatible with complete reallocation depending on old tie selection; regularity repairs explicit.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b2a: Firm fixed-cost activation threshold and household corners cover every nonnegative price; no original deterministic equilibrium.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b2b: Unique active objective root compared with actual shutdown, not FOC alone. Real-resource feasibility and positive net gain proved.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b2c: Conditional operating subsidy exactly covers fixed-cost shortfall; explicit operation-at-tie selection and household tax close all accounts.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b2d: Convexified expected production vector is not deterministic plant capability. Lottery welfare and many-plant pooling assumptions distinguished.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b3a: Global type conditional quadratic replies on compact domain and full four-coordinate contraction prove unique Bayesian equilibrium; symmetry not assumed.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b3b: Wrong complete-information policy has same aggregate mean but strictly profitable type deviations; mean fit not equilibrium.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b3c: Own-cost information under correlated law changes beliefs and strategies; marginal frequencies identical, variance and profits distinct.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b3d: Joint cost/timing observations distinguish laws; actual information of firms, demand confounds and market dependence require independent evidence.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b4a: Full and partial assignments exhaust allocation possibilities; pair inequalities imply no coalition gain through additive disjoint production.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b4b: Complete supporting payoff polytope, nonnegative bounds, two divisions and total surplus verify assignment versus payoff uniqueness.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b4c: Technology perturbation changes budget and core inequalities; old payoff unfunded and repaired vector both funded and stable.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b4d: Transferable utility, outside options, contracting and unobserved bargaining selection delimit empirical wage inference.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b5a: Complete positive-CARA risk family derived from exact full insurance reservation; risk-neutral boundary and distinct world observational equivalence.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b5b: Partial premium derived from expected utility; actual accepting population and expected insurer payments accounted, binary response only set identification.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b5c: Global interior binomial MLE and structural inverse domain derived; finite sample and reservation measurement uncertainty not erased.
exact_prompt_solution_audit.graduate-micro-b5d: Strict convexity proves reservation ratio strictly increasing and full range; exact contrast identifies within maintained family, insurance selection/effort can invalidate risk transport.

scope: Two original 100-point forms, five 20-point essential domains each and forty complete five-point solutions. Full proof and exact prompt/rubric audit, all source routes read, actual scored V12 bridges in training identification and insurance evidence.
distinctness: A constructs smooth duality/pollution implementation/repeated incentives/bilateral trade/causal training. B diagnoses nonconvex choice/fixed-cost failure/joint-information mistakes/assignment payoff selection/insurance observational equivalence. No parameter-only reassessment and no copied V13 volume problems. B5 was chosen to avoid the econometrics field posted-price/minimax task.
proof_limits: A3 finite-horizon backward induction is explicitly restricted to pure strategies; infinite-horizon grim sufficiency permits arbitrary deviations via bounded-tail truncation.
A4 impossibility is for the exact efficient rule, DSIC/ex-post IR and zero no-trade transfer normalization, not an unproved general Bayesian impossibility theorem.
B2 operating subsidy requires the stated activation-at-indifference selection.
Finite samples and synthetic models do not certify population identification, empirical welfare or institutional exam equivalence.
source_review: Five precise inherited primary method routes; historical primary inspection scopes remain attributed. Original elementary finite/continuous model proofs independently derived; no new empirical or current-law assertion.
validation: Quiet exact-four checker parses all forty prompts/answers/rubrics, both form/domain scores, visible primitives/results, source URLs and three nonself hashes; numerical witnesses supplement full global proofs. Actual normal/optimized portable gates retained separately after final freeze.
resolved_peer_findings: B5 likelihood route corrected to v12-c04.
A5 explicitly stipulates earnings as real net output accruing as income without omitted employer loss or production cost, with C additional real training cost.
